name: git-workflows
description: Parallel-session-safe git lifecycle skills for updating, resetting, merging with exact branch and worktree cleanup, and publishing documentation-only changes to the default branch.

interface.shortDescription: Safe git lifecycle workflows for agent sessions.
interface.longDescription: Parallel-session-safe git workflow skills from Mike Rihm's toolkit. Includes pull-latest for safe updating, reset-to-remote for explicit remote mirroring, merge-and-clean-up for landing an approved pull request and removing only its completed workspace, and publish-docs for preparing an authorized documentation save in an isolated worktree before pushing directly to the default branch.
defaultPrompt: Merge this pull request and clean up its branch and worktree
Publish this documentation change to the default branch
